chapters.visual_plan: Hero badge 'AIアーキテクチャ解説' + heading 'Looped Transformer：『同じ層を回す』第3の進化'. Middle 2-column grid: Left card '従来の2大アプローチ' (①巨大化: パラメータ N 増大, ②CoT: 出力トークン長 T_CoT 増大). Right card '第3の軸：Recurrent Depth (R)' with animated SVG core loop ring (Loop 1 -> 2 -> ... -> R, shared weights θ, Test-Time Compute pill). Bottom row of 3 goal pills ('1 漸化式と計算機理論', '2 CoT vs 潜在推論・動的深さ', '3 力学系の壁と最新LLM') with margin: 0 212px so corners never touch Metan or Zundamon.

Phase A (c2_compare_intro..c2_eff_depth): Side-by-side comparison. Left card: Standard Transformer vertical layer stack (L1 -> L2 -> ... -> LN, unique weights θ_1 != θ_2 != ..., formula h^(l+1) = f_{θ_l}(h^(l))). Right card: Looped Transformer SVG diagram showing Prelude P(x)->e -> shared Recurrent Core f_θ with looping feedback arc + animated glowing orb moving around the loop + dashed Input Injection (+e) arrow -> Coda C(h^(R)), math box 'h^(r+1) = f_θ(h^(r), e)', and bottom formula bar '実効深さ L_eff = L_pre + R · L_core + L_coda' (keep padding-bottom clear). Phase B (c2_phase2_theory..c2_bridge): At c2_phase2_theory fade Phase A out (opacity 0), bring Phase B in (opacity 1) AND show left card immediately at tP2+0.35 (no blank gap). Two side-by-side theory cards: Left '理論① プログラム可能なコンピュータ（ICML 2023）' with CPU fetch/execute/memory cycle SVG mapped to f_θ x R loops + SUBLEQ callout; Right '理論② 長さ汎化（Length Generalization）' comparing fixed-depth memorization vs learning 1-step update rule f_θ and scaling R=4->12 at inference.

Phase B (c3_phase2_adaptive..c3_wrap): At c3_phase2_adaptive fade Phase A out, bring Phase B in, and show top formula bar + token bars immediately at tP2+0.35. Top bar formula: '停止確率（Halting）：各周で p_r ∈ (0,1) を予測 → 累積 Σ p_r >= 1 - ε で早期脱出（ACT / MoR）'. Center animated vertical bar chart across 6 sentence tokens ('次の': 2周, '方程式': 6周, 'x^2-5x+6=0': 16周!, 'の': 1周, '解は': 4周, 'x=2,3': 12周) animated with scaleY from bottom origin (no CSS transform before GSAP!). Bottom callout 'Mixture-of-Recursions (MoR)：ルーターがトークンごとにループ回数を動的配分' with margin: 0 240px.
